tools.description: Describe one table: columns and types, primary key, foreign keys in both directions, indexes, estimated rows, and which columns will be pseudonymized and as which kind.

tools.description: Show the execution plan of one read-only SQL statement (EXPLAIN without ANALYZE, FORMAT TEXT, JSON or YAML). Literals in the plan are pseudonymized.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database on the same server to use instead of the connection's default database

sql.description: One read-only SQL statement to explain

tools.name: explain

tools.description: List the PostgreSQL connections found in the developer's DBeaver workspace, with status (available, unavailable, unsupported), reason and connection type (dev, test, prod). Never returns hosts or credentials.
tools.name: list_connections

tools.description: List tables and views of a connection, one compact line each with kind, estimated rows and column count. Paginated with limit.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database on the same server to use instead of the connection's default database

limit.description: Maximum number of tables returned (default 100, maximum 500)

name_like.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against table names

offset.description: Number of tables to skip, for pagination

tools.name: list_tables

tools.description: Run one read-only SQL statement and get rows with every personal value pseudonymized. Defaults: 50 rows, 16 KB, 10 s; maxima 500 rows, 64 KB, 60 s (max_rows, max_bytes, timeout_ms). Text cells are cut at 500 characters; read the rest with cell_offset. Sorting, ranges, LIKE, length and hashing act on real values.

cell_offset.description: Characters to skip at the start of every text cell before the 500-character cap; repeat a query with the offset given in a cell truncation to read the rest of a long value

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database on the same server to use instead of the connection's default database

max_bytes.description: Maximum size of the returned rows in bytes (default 16384, maximum 65536)

tools.name: query

tools.description: Find tables and columns whose name matches a pattern (case-insensitive) in one connection. Use it to locate where data lives before writing SQL.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database on the same server to use instead of the connection's default database

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against table and column names

tools.name: search_schema

tools.description: Return the live limits, the pseudonym kinds that can or cannot be reused in filters, the operations that act on real values, and the known limitations.
